stories.title: AlgoFET raises ₹15 crore for autonomous drone infrastructure
stories.summary: AlgoFET’s Pre-Series A round from Piper Serica will support the ground systems behind autonomous drone operations: docking, charging, battery management and mission readiness.
stories.dateNote: The official homepage carousel states the round but gives no publication date.

metric.label: Pre-Series A
metric.context: AlgoFET company financing from Piper Serica; not a grant or funding amount received by ARTPARK.

supportingSources.supports: Founder Ankit Mishra’s engineer-to-founder journey and the autonomous charging technology; this older feature does not establish the later funding round.

stories.title: Yaanendriya raises ₹15 crore for indigenous navigation and sensing
stories.summary: Built from research at ARTPARK, Yaanendriya secured its first institutional round from Piper Serica to develop navigation and sensing technology for autonomous systems.
stories.dateNote: The readable post shows a relative age, not an independently verified calendar publication date.

metric.label: First institutional round
metric.context: Amount reported by ARTPARK in its original post embedded in Raghu Dharmaraju’s repost.

supportingSources.supports: Company confirms Piper Serica investment and support from the ARTPARK/IISc ecosystem.

stories.title: QOSMIC raises $3.33 million to connect orbit and Earth
stories.summary: QOSMIC is developing optical communication infrastructure for satellites and ground stations. Its announced seed round is led by Accel and Prosus, with early support from ARTPARK and South Park Commons.
stories.dateNote: The readable primary post shows a relative age. Do not substitute a search-engine crawl date or infer an announcement date.

metric.label: Seed round
metric.context: Funding announced by founder Shreyaans Jain in the post shared by ARTPARK; a company round, not ARTPARK’s own funding.

stories.title: Project Vaani opens more of India’s language landscape
stories.summary: The first Phase 2 tranche expanded Vaani’s open speech resources into 40 additional districts. The IISc–ARTPARK initiative, funded by Google, provides real-world speech data for Indian-language AI.
stories.dateNote: Phase 2 is an existing release milestone, not a newly dated October 2026 announcement.

metric.label: Additional districts in the first Phase 2 tranche
metric.context: ARTPARK’s release post reports approximately 5,500 raw speech hours; the homepage rounds this to an additional 5,000 hours. This is not the current total dataset size.

currentProjectSnapshot.context: Cumulative values read from the live project dashboard; distinguish these from the first Phase 2 tranche.

supportingSources.publisher: ARTPARK original post embedded in a project team member’s repost

stories.title: 51 teams put their 5G prototypes to the test at ARTPARK
stories.summary: Teams demonstrated healthcare, agriculture and manufacturing use cases during the 5G Innovation Hackathon evaluation at ARTPARK, using working 5G infrastructure.
stories.dateNote: September 15–17 is the demonstration event window, not a verified post publication date.

metric.label: Prototype demonstrations
metric.context: Count reported in ARTPARK’s publicly indexed LinkedIn update, not a portfolio-company or programme cohort count.

supportingSources.supports: Publicly indexed company update naming 51 teams and September 15–17.
Current carousel feature for the CoE’s real-world 5G infrastructure.

stories.editorialNote: An exact individual LinkedIn post permalink was not verified. Use the official CoE destination, and do not present this past event as upcoming.

stories.title: Reading environmental signals before they become health crises
stories.summary: Dharini brings environmental surveillance into ARTPARK’s One Health work, connecting signals from water, soil and air with the earlier identification of potential public-health threats.
stories.dateNote: Date shown on ARTPARK’s Stories listing for its World Environment Day article.

supportingSources.supports: Article title, summary and June 5, 2026 listing date.

stories.editorialNote: Describe a surveillance platform and intended capability; do not invent disease-prevention outcomes or deployment totals.

stories.title: ARTPARK welcomes its first TIR cohort
stories.summary: ARTPARK announced 20 teams for its first Technology Innovators in Residence cohort after reviewing applications from across India.
stories.dateNote: Found in the publicly indexed ARTPARK company feed; only a relative publication age was available.

metric.label: TIR Cohort 1
metric.context: Selected cohort size; the same announcement reports more than 350 applications and over 50 interviews.

supportingSources.supports: Programme detail destination; do not infer that applications are currently open.

stories.editorialNote: Exact individual announcement permalink was not verified. Avoid an Apply now claim until current programme status is reconciled.

stories.title: ARTPARK named among the inaugural RDI Fund cohort
stories.summary: ARTPARK reports selection among five Focused Research Organisations in the inaugural Research, Development and Innovation Fund cohort.
stories.dateNote: Readable public company feed gives a relative age, not a verified calendar date.

metric.label: Focused Research Organisations
metric.context: ARTPARK’s announcement. No specific funding allocation to ARTPARK is stated.

stories.editorialNote: The national RDI Fund’s ₹1 lakh crore size is not an award or allocation to ARTPARK. An exact individual post permalink and independent selection list were not verified.

notes: Research checked on 2026-10-24 using primary ARTPARK/project/company sources and publicly readable/indexed LinkedIn material. Summaries are original paraphrases; no founder quotations have been invented.

The requested https://www.linkedin.com/company/artpark-in/posts/?feedView=all redirected an unauthenticated real Chrome browser to LinkedIn sign-in. The web fetch was also denied by robots.txt. This is not a review of the authenticated feed.

Public individual LinkedIn posts and the public indexed https://in.linkedin.com/company/artpark-in page were readable. Where no individual permalink was verified, the record says so and links the exact public company page.
Null publicationDate means no exact publication date was verified. Do not turn relative ages, crawl dates, funding event dates or programme event dates into publication dates.
Vaani’s first Phase 2 tranche and its cumulative current dashboard are distinct measures. The older banner is not evidence of a new release today.
Financial metrics are financing raised by the named portfolio company, never revenue generated or funding received by ARTPARK.

The ARTPARK story URL ending blog-post-title-four-kpyhe has an anomalous 2019 year in the Stories listing despite contemporary content. It is used for founder/technology context only, not as a verified funding-announcement date.
Some programme and social pages have conflicting open/closed labels. These records intentionally avoid asserting that applications are open. No live form was submitted and no account was accessed.
